chapter.verse: Pasian' deihna tawh Khris Jesu' sawltak khat ahi keimah Paul in Ephesus khua-a mi siangthote leh Khris Jesu' sunga thu-um citakte kong hopih hi:
Note' tungah hehpihna hong tung henla i Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesu Khris' kiangpan nopna lemna hong om ta hen.
Van gamhuam pana kha thupha a namkim tawh Khris' sungah eite maipha hong pia i Topa Jesu Khris ii Pa leh Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen.
Ama' mai-ah a siangtho leh a sitbaanglo i hih theih nadingin Pasian in leitung a kilamkip ma-in itna tawh Khris' sungah eite hong teel hi.
Ama' lungdeih leh lungkimna tawh kizui-in Jesu Khris tungtawnin ama' tate hong suaksak dingin eite hong sehkholhsa ahi hi.
Tua pen ama' Itpa' sungah hong angvan piak thupha ahi ama' hehpihna a minpha a kiphat nading ahi hi.
Ama' hong hehpihna a tampi tawh kizui-in eite in ama' sisan hangin ama' sungah tatkhiatna—i tatkhialhnate pan mawhmaina—i ngah hi.
Amah in pilna leh ciimna a namkim tungtawnin eite' tungah tua hehpihna a dimletin hong pia a,
Khris sungah a geelsa ahi ama' ngimna tawh kizui-in eite' tungah ama' lungdeih thusim hong kilangsak hi.
Tua pen Khris' sungah na khempeuh—vantunga om nate leh leitunga om nate, a vekin—gawmtuah ding cih, kicinna hun' ading geelna hawmna ahi hi.
Ama' deihgeelna tawh kizui-in na khempeuh a bawl Pasian, tua Pasian ii ngimna tawh kizui-in hong kisehkhol eite zong Khris' sungah gamhluah za hong kiguan khinzo hi.
Tua pen Khris a lamen masa dingte ahi eite, ama' minpha a kiphatna i suah nading ahi hi.
Note zong thumaan thutak thu, note hong kihotkhiatna tawh kipawl Lungdamna Thu, za-in na up uh ciangin hong kikamciam Kha Siangtho tawh Khris' sungah ciaptehna gip hong kibelh hi.
Tua Kha Siangtho pen i luah ding gamh khamkholhna hi a, Pasian' neihsate a kitatkhiat masung, ama' minpha a kiphat nading ahi hi.
Hih thu hangin Topa Jesu Khris na upna uh leh mi siangtho khempeuh na itna uh na za khinzo ka hih manin
ka thungetnate ah note hong phawkin note' taangin tatsat lo-in lungdam ka ko hi.
I Topa Jesu Khris ii Pasian, minphatna ii Pa in pilna Kha leh amah theihna cingtaak a piangsak kilaakna hong pia ta hen.
Na lungsim mitte uh hong vaksak khin ahih zah khatin ama' hong sapkhiatna ah bang lametna om cih ahi zongin, mi siangthote' ngah ama' minpha tawh a kituam gamh bangzahin kicing cih ahi zongin,
a gamtang ama' ukzawhna lianpi tawh kizui-in thu-um eite' tunga a hong kilang tehtheihloh ama' vanglian thupi bangzahin thakhauh cih ahi zongin, hih thute thei ta un.
Amah in tua vanglian thupi tawh Khris sungah nasem a, misite' lakpan Khris thokiksakin van gamhuam sung ama' taklam ah tusak hi.

Tua vanglian thupi pen zaliatna, uktheihna, vangliatna leh topa hihna, cih teng khempeuh sangin tungnungzaw pek a, tu khanghun bek hilo, hong tung ding khanghun sunga min a kilo khempeuh sangin zong tungnungzaw hi.
Amah in na khempeuh Khris' khe nuai-ah koih a, na khempeuh ii lutang ahi dingin pawlpi' tungah pia hi.
Pawlpi cih pen Khris' pumpi hi a, na khempeuh a huamkimpa ii cingtaakna bup ahi hi.
